# ARIEC60870

ARIEC60870 is a field-tested IEC 60870 evidence analyzer and learning-friendly protocol review tool for IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103, and IEC 60870-5-104 engineering workflows.

## Main pages
- Home: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/
- Indonesian home: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/id/
- Field Wiki: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/wiki.html
- FAQ: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/faq.html
- Download: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/download.html

## Field Wiki topics
- IEC-101 ACD and DFC: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec101-acd-dfc.html
- IEC-101 Class 1 and Class 2 polling: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec101-polling-class1-class2.html
- IEC-101 command flow: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec101-command-flow.html
- IEC-101 Common Address vs Link Address: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec101-addressing.html
- IEC-101 General Interrogation: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec101-general-interrogation.html
- IEC-104 STARTDT STOPDT TESTFR: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec104-startdt-stopdt-testfr.html
- IEC-103 relay events: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/iec103-relay-events.html
- Smart Findings: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/smart-findings.html

## Product boundary
ARIEC60870 is an engineering evidence analyzer. It is not a production SCADA system, gateway, protection device, or certified conformance test suite.
